goalDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann räumliche Objekte im dreidimensionalen Koordinatensystem verorten und geeignete Koordinatenbezüge wählen.
audience: Gymnasium Sekundarstufe II, GK und LK gemäß aktuellem Zielkontext
model: Exact serving model identifier not exposed

selfReview.method: Actual generated PNG visually inspected after generation; all eight coordinate labels, axis directions and three measurement annotations checked.
correctedDefects: Ambiguous x=4 labels and misplaced y=3 label replaced by endpoint-bound AB = 4 and BC = 3 dimension arrows.
Height has its own vertical dimension arrow from the level of D to the level of H, labelled Höhe = 2.
Unexplained upper dashed horizontal line and right-face interior dashed vertical line removed.
checks: A=(0|0|0), B=(4|0|0), C=(4|3|0), D=(0|3|0) form the correct base rectangle in the displayed oblique projection.
E=(0|0|2), F=(4|0|2), G=(4|3|2), H=(0|3|2) lie above their matching base corners.
Positive x extends from A through B to lower left, y from A through D rightward, and z from A through E upward.
The AB dimension arrow is parallel to the depth direction and attached near A and B; the BC dimension arrow spans the front horizontal edge.
Hidden-edge dashes near A remain distinguishable from the removed unexplained interior lines. The A–D line is interrupted by the large origin label; no extra section geometry is implied.
All coordinate values, German title and dimensions are readable; friendly hand-drawn character and light-blue graph-paper backdrop retained.
No visible technical ID, watermark, logo or unrelated topic.
limitations: This is the creating agent's AI self-review; a subsequent independent visual/fachliche review is still required.
Independent QA should also check the unobtrusive hidden-edge depiction behind the origin label.
No cockpit or rendered learner-book acceptance test was performed for this unimported candidate.
Generated edit preserves the composition but is not asserted to preserve every source pixel.

suggestedAltTextDe: Quader im dreidimensionalen Koordinatensystem mit Ursprung A=(0|0|0), B=(4|0|0), C=(4|3|0), D=(0|3|0) und den darüberliegenden Ecken bei z=2. Eindeutig zugeordnete Maßpfeile zeigen AB=4 in x-Richtung, BC=3 in y-Richtung und die Höhe 2. Die positiven Achsen verlaufen von A durch B, D beziehungsweise E.
